The process_birthday_wishes and process_anniversary_wishes functions correctly retrieve respective variable counts from auto_message_settings

context_for_next_testing_agent: Template variable count feature tested and working. The fix addresses the bug where hardcoded field_1, field_2, field_3 were sent regardless of template requirements. Now the payload dynamically builds only the exact number of fields needed (1-5) based on user-configured templateVariableCount setting.

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Application was sending hardcoded template variable fields (field_1, field_2, field_3) to BizChat API regardless of how many variables the template actually requires, causing 400/422 errors
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Dynamic payload building based on templateVariableCount setting - only includes fields up to the configured count
bug_fix_verification.verified_by: API tests confirm templateVariableCount is stored and retrieved correctly from both reminder_settings and auto_message_settings collections
